title: MARS: Harmonizing Multimodal Convergence via Adaptive Rank Search
abstract: arXiv:2603.00720v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fine-tuning Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with parameter-efficient methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is crucial for task adaptation. However, imbalanced training dynamics across modalities often lead to suboptimal accuracy due to negative interference, a challenge typically addressed with inefficient heuristic methods such as manually tuning separate learning rates. To overcome this, we introduce MARS (Multimodal Adaptive Rank Search), an approach to discover optimal rank pairs that balance training dynamics while maximizing performance. Our key innovation, a proposed framework of dual scaling laws, enables this search: one law models module-specific convergence time to prune the search space to candidates with aligned dynamics, while the other predicts final task performance to select the optimal pair from the pruned set. translated_title: MARS：通过自适应秩搜索实现多模态收敛的协调
translated_abstract: 使用低秩适应（LoRA）等参数高效方法对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进行微调对于任务适配至关重要。然而，跨模态之间不平衡的训练动态常常因负面干扰而导致次优的准确率，这一挑战通常采用低效的启发式方法来解决，例如手动调整不同模态的学习率。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了MARS（多模态自适应秩搜索），一种能够发现最佳秩对的方法，在平衡训练动态的同时最大化性能。我们的关键创新是提出的双缩放定律框架，为该搜索提供了支撑：一个定律建模模块特定的收敛时间，将搜索空间剪枝为动态对齐的候选集合；另一个定律则预测最终任务性能，从剪枝后的集合中选出最优的秩对。通过将LoRA的秩重新用作控制模态特定收敛速度的控制器，MARS在……
tldr: 提出MARS方法，利用双缩放定律自适应搜索LoRA秩对，以平衡多模态大语言模型微调中不同模态的收敛速度，避免负面干扰并提升任务性能。
en_tdlr: MARS leverages dual scaling laws to adaptively search for optimal LoRA rank pairs that balance modality-specific convergence speeds in MLLM fine-tuning, mitigating negative interference and maximizing task performance.
